first_place_gold.badge_bg: bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 via-amber-400 to-yellow-600 text-zinc-950 font-black

second_place_blue.badge_bg: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-cyan-500 to-blue-500 text-white font-black

visual_enhancers.podium_frame_aspect_ratio: vertical rectangular portrait (2:1 or 3:4 ratio, roughly 6cm x 3cm scaled, max-height 320px)
visual_enhancers.podium_backlights: pulsing backlighting glow behind top 3 seller portraits: 1st Gold, 2nd Blue, 3rd White/Silver
visual_enhancers.discreet_admin_trigger: Discrete 'nivelinha' floating trigger at bottom-right corner (small icon, low-opacity, reveals admin authentication modal)
visual_enhancers.tv_display_mode: Auto-scrolling or clean multi-column layout optimized for big screens & TVs with 10s auto-refresh sync

key_components_structure.name: Header & Brand Logo Slot
key_components_structure.description: Top section featuring a massive customizable brand logo container, live indicator, title edit display ('Ranking de Outubro'), and month switcher dropdown for archive viewing.

key_components_structure.name: Top 3 Podium Showcase
key_components_structure.description: Central hero section with vertical rectangular portrait frames for 1st (Gold), 2nd (Blue), and 3rd (White) place reps with animated pulsating backlights, crowns/badges, rep names, and optional metric numbers.

key_components_structure.name: Sequential Sellers List (4th Place Onward)
key_components_structure.description: Grid or double-column list of all remaining representatives (up to 49+), showing position rank, photo avatar, name, region/unit, and conditional stats.

key_components_structure.name: Discreet Admin Access Button ('Nivelinha')
key_components_structure.description: Subtle, semi-transparent icon button in the bottom-right corner that triggers the Admin Password Modal.

key_components_structure.name: Admin Control Panel Modal / View
key_components_structure.description: Full management dashboard for admins to: set active month, edit ranking title, toggle visibility of numbers/stats, drag-and-drop or manually set seller positions, add/edit/delete reps with custom photo uploads, and update brand logo.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in Portuguese (pt-BR) as specified by the user prompt (e.g., 'Ranking de Outubro', 'Representante', 'Entrar como Administrador', 'Visibilidade de Valores').
The podium for top 3 must prominently feature high vertical rectangular portrait frames (2:1 / 3:4 aspect ratio) to resemble physical framed portraits.
Implement the animated pulsing backlight effects strictly per requirements: Gold for 1st, Electric Blue for 2nd, Crisp White/Silver for 3rd.
Include a huge logo spot at the top of the site with upload/change capability in the admin panel.
Place a discrete 'nivelinha' floating action button at the bottom-right for admin authentication.
The default view displays ONLY positions (1º, 2º, 3º, 4º...). Sales numbers/metrics are hidden by default and only visible to Admin when toggled ON in the admin panel.
Ensure seamless auto-refresh polling so TV displays reflect live admin reorders instantly.
Include mock data with up to 49 default representatives, allowing the user to add/edit/reorder as many as desired.
Every interactive element and key text node MUST include data-testid attributes.
